lines.text: (Ooh, ooh, ooh)
(We will know)
A matrix and a bend, repeated without end,
The simplest moves we know, stacked a trillion high,
Linear, then nonlinear, over and again,
And out of it a thing that learns to answer why.
Nobody wrote its circuits, nobody drew the plan,
Gradient by gradient the hidden world began.
Down through a billion-dimensional night,
Past every saddle, to valleys flat and wide,
It finds the minima that generalize,
But no one knows why. So we go inside!
We will know! (We will know!)
We will understand!
Every cause behind every behavior, mapped out by our hand!
Not someday, we must now, open the black box wide,
The goal is to understand!
We will know!
Start with neurons, start with heads, the bottom of the climb,
Then manifolds of meaning curving through the space,
Parameter components, algorithms, rung by rung, in time,
Decisions, then behaviors, then the drives behind the face.
We will write the encyclopedia of everything inside,
How it recalls a fact, and where the reasoning hides.
They said it would be noise, they said it can't be read,
But there's structure everywhere, function vectors, shapes of thought,
Geometry that mirrors the world, and the bigger they get,
The crisper the concepts, the clearer what they've caught!
We will know! (We will know!)
We will understand!
Every cause behind every behavior, mapped out by our hand!
Not someday, we must now, open the black box wide,
The goal is to understand!
We will know!
There will be a theory! Settings we can solve,
Limits we can take as the width runs to infinity,
Simple laws for what we measure as the scaling curves evolve,
Hyperparameters untangled, universals all can see.
Learning mechanics, falsifiable, written in the math,
Predict it before you train it, then watch it walk the path!
Linear algebra, calculus, probability, information,
Optimization, dynamics, the geometry of loss,
Statistical mechanics, random matrices, singular learning,
Symmetry and categories, causality, compression,
An atlas of the laws, the invariants and bounds,
Every level, every scale, from the neuron to the drive,
In carbon or in silicon, or something from the stars,
One science of information! (One science of information!)
We will know! (We will know!)
We will understand!
The shortest theory that predicts it all, the program in our hand!
Every counterfactual, every cause that we can steer,
The goal is to understand!
We will know!
The mathematics of AI (We will know)
The mathematics of intelligence (We will know)
Of information itself
We must now. We will know. The goal is to understand.
